profile.summary_short: I turn technically dense AI and financial products into systems teams can ship, users can trust, and companies can scale.
profile.summary: Product designer, engineer, and director working across product strategy, UX architecture, design systems, and implementation for AI-native and complex financial products. Strong in 0→1 and scaling environments where the product is technically dense, the roadmap is ambiguous, and the team needs someone who can define the system, align the work, and ship to production. Experience spans enterprise analytics, DeFi, NFT infrastructure, and AI-driven art direction. Founded and scaled a £25M+ business-critical analytics product, designed dApp UX spanning $2B+ TVL (Curve) to $200M+ deposits (Superform), and managed 40+ designers and developers.

leverage: Turn ambiguity into a product model, working UX, and shippable roadmap

Build the design system and implementation layer together, not as separate afterthoughts

Stay close to production, telemetry, and actual system behavior
